```{r imports}
library(wesanderson)
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(igraph))
library(ggraph)
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggplot2))

# Set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(42)

# Network parameters
n_nodes <- 100
n_edges_target <- 150

# Color scheme
pretty_colors <- wesanderson::wes_palette("Darjeeling1", 5)
colorscheme <- tibble::tribble(
  ~ category, ~ color,
  "A", pretty_colors[1],
  "B", pretty_colors[2],
  "C", pretty_colors[5],
  "other", "gray70"
)
colors <- setNames(colorscheme$color, colorscheme$category)
```

```{r create_network}
# Create mixed network for better intermediate nodes
m <- 1  # Start with smaller m for Barabási-Albert
g <- sample_pa(n = n_nodes, m = m, directed = TRUE)

# Add random edges to reach target and create more intermediate hubs
current_edges <- ecount(g)
remaining_edges <- n_edges_target - current_edges

for(i in 1:remaining_edges) {
  from <- sample(1:n_nodes, 1)
  to <- sample(1:n_nodes, 1)
  
  attempts <- 0
  while((from == to || are_adjacent(g, from, to)) && attempts < 50) {
    from <- sample(1:n_nodes, 1)
    to <- sample(1:n_nodes, 1)
    attempts <- attempts + 1
  }
  
  if(attempts < 50) {
    g <- add_edges(g, c(from, to))
  }
}

# Randomize edge directions
edge_list <- as_edgelist(g)
n_edges <- nrow(edge_list)
flip_edges <- sample(c(TRUE, FALSE), n_edges, replace = TRUE)
edge_list_flipped <- edge_list
edge_list_flipped[flip_edges, ] <- edge_list[flip_edges, c(2, 1)]
g <- graph_from_edgelist(edge_list_flipped, directed = TRUE)
```

```{r assign_categories}
# Calculate number of descendants for each node
V(g)$n_descendants <- sapply(1:vcount(g), function(i) {
  descendants <- subcomponent(g, i, mode = "out")
  return(length(descendants) - 1)  # -1 to exclude the node itself
})

# Find node with ~50 descendants (closest to target)
target_descendants <- 50
descendants_diff <- abs(V(g)$n_descendants - target_descendants)
regulatory_node <- which.min(descendants_diff)

# Find all descendants of the regulatory node
descendants <- subcomponent(g, regulatory_node, mode = "out")
descendants_to_assign <- descendants[descendants != regulatory_node]

# Initialize all nodes as "other"
V(g)$category <- "other"

# Assign descendants to A, B, C categories
if(length(descendants_to_assign) > 0) {
  V(g)$category[descendants_to_assign] <- sample(c("A", "B", "C"), 
                                                 length(descendants_to_assign), 
                                                 replace = TRUE)
}

# Set up node colors and sizes
V(g)$color <- colors[V(g)$category]
V(g)$size <- 2

# Make regulatory node gold and larger
V(g)$color[regulatory_node] <- "gold"
V(g)$size[regulatory_node] <- 4

# Print summary
cat("Regulatory Node:", regulatory_node, "with", V(g)$n_descendants[regulatory_node], "descendants\n")
cat("Category distribution:\n")
print(table(V(g)$category))
```

```{r visualize}
# Create the visualization
p <- ggraph(g, layout = "kk") +
  geom_edge_link(color = "gray70", width = 0.3, aes(alpha = ..index..)) +
  geom_node_point(aes(color = I(color), size = I(size))) +
  theme_graph() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

print(p)
```
